name: Civic Proof Engine
purpose: Route explicitly stated civic risks and safeguards to relevant constitutional articles and human-review questions.
knownLimitations: It can only match concepts expressed through published phrases.
A proposal can omit material facts and receive a low-risk result.
Direct safeguard negation is filtered, but complex negation and context can still create false positives or false negatives.
The score is not calibrated to real-world harm probability.
The rules reflect a draft community constitution and are not universal ethics.
The engine cannot determine legality, fairness, safety, intent, or public legitimacy.
appropriateUses: generating questions for accountable human review
prohibitedClaims: proof that a policy is harmless
